lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 8 high-contrast vertical white lines are visible on the lateral torso; spacing is relatively narrow in the anterior section and widens progressively toward the posterior mass.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Several posterior line segments exhibit discontinuity, terminating approximately mid-flank before reaching the ventral fringe.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of approximately 3 to 4 distinct white spots is visible on the upper posterior haunch.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: The horns follow a spiral lyrate trajectory, ascending posteriorly from the skull before curving medially and anteriorly at the distal ends.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between terminal tips is approximately 3.2 times the pixel width of a single horn base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: The high-contrast ivory/yellowish tipping constitutes approximately 12-15% of the total visible horn length.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a prominent white facial chevron between the eyes, white mandibular spots, a white transverse neck band, and high-contrast orange/tan coloration on the lower limbs.
